data.summary: ScreenStream MVP shipped: 1) screenstream_daemon.py (PIL.ImageGrab + 1080p resize + JPEG q65 + ring buffer 600 frames + atomic write + _latest.jpg copy + config toggle live reload) 2) RCG_ScreenStreamDaemon.cs (Editor InitializeOnLoad spawn + Tick respawn + graceful kill on quit) 3) .gitignore _screenstream/ 4) docs/Workflows/ScreenStream_Workflow.md (隱私第一原則 + toggle 指南 + agent 讀法 + capacity 表 + 觀戰場景 + 故障排除). 順便修了 PIL Recuva 污染. Smoke test: 真實 screenshot 2560x1600 → resize 1080p → ~195KB JPEG. 預設 OFF, Tim 顯式 toggle on 才開始 capture. 沒做 audio (v2 backlog, agent 直接讀檔已夠用).
